services.name: Dorchester Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: The Best Riding Areas in Ocean City! Please Note: Drivers must be ages 18 with a guardian being at least 21 to sign paperwork and passengers must be ages 5 and up. Duration 1 Hour About A one-hour long jet ski ride in which our guides will take you out on a short 10-15 minute ride out to the riding area. Once at the riding area the guests will be able to have 30-40 minutes of free riding time in one of the largest free-riding areas in Ocean City. What to Bring Important: All drivers will need a valid photo ID Sunscreen (We also offer the ability to buy in-store) Towel Water Sunglasses and Hats (At your own risk) Provided Life vests (Must be worn at all times) Jetski Instructional Review
